title: Introducing gpt-oss
summary: We’re releasing gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b—two state-of-the-art open-weight language models that deliver strong real-world performance at low cost. Available under the flexible Apache 2.0 license, these models outperform similarly sized open models on reasoning tasks, demonstrate strong tool use capabilities, and are optimized for efficient deployment on consumer hardware.
body: We’re releasing gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b—two state-of-the-art open-weight language models that deliver strong real-world performance at low cost. Available under the flexible Apache 2.0 license, these models outperform similarly sized open models on reasoning tasks, demonstrate strong tool use capabilities, and are optimized for efficient deployment on consumer hardware.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了gpt-oss-120b和gpt-oss-20b两款开源权重模型，采用Apache 2.0协议。这两款模型在推理任务和工具调用能力上表现优异，且针对消费级硬件进行了部署优化。作为OpenAI在开源领域的重大尝试，该系列模型旨在提供高性价比的解决方案，支持开发者构建复杂的智能体应用，同时保持了极高的推理效率，是目前开源模型领域的重要补充。
